name: ISLE Portable
description:
ISLE is an open-source modern source port of LEGO Island (1997), the beloved open-world adventure game. It restores compatibility with modern 64-bit operating systems, high-resolution screens, and modern audio hardware.

Features:
- Native execution on modern operating systems without legacy DirectX limitations
- Widescreen and arbitrary resolution rendering with scalable user interfaces
- Corrected physics timing and animation glitches caused by modern CPU clock speeds
- Support for modern gamepads and remappable keyboard controls
- Requires original LEGO Island game files to run
